0.34.1-xray-overlay: The Encryption X-Ray - the split view that shows your readable note beside the exact ciphertext stored on the server - was anchored to the note's full length, so its divider drifted off-screen on long notes and the panel sat half off the screen on short ones. It now stays pinned to the visible editor area and remembers your split position, with snap points and keyboard control. Open it from the lock icon in the note toolbar.
0.34.0-linked-notes: A linked-notes panel gathers a note's backlinks (every note that links to it) and its outgoing links in one place, so you can move through connected notes in both directions.
0.34.0-import-links: Markdown import can now optionally rewrite links between notes - both standard Markdown links and Obsidian-style [[wikilinks]] - into working in-app links, so an imported vault stays navigable.
0.33.0-native-folder-sync: On Android and iOS you can mirror a folder of files from your device into your notes, keeping it in step as things change.
0.33.0-native-sync-speed: Sync on mobile now fetches version history only for the notes that actually changed, instead of for every note, cutting both data use and sync time.
0.33.0-ios-2fa: On iOS the two-factor field accepted only five of the six digits; you can now enter the full code.
0.32.1-tag-autocomplete: Tag autocomplete now supports keyboard navigation - arrow keys to move through suggestions, Enter to pick - and clears the typed text once you choose a tag.
0.32.0-sync-errors: When the server rejects a change (for example a validation error or a size limit), the affected note or task now shows a clear, per-item sync error instead of failing silently - nothing fails to save without you knowing.
0.32.0-large-notes: Notes larger than the server's request-size limit could not sync. The limit was raised so long notes upload reliably.
0.32.0-task-trash: The task detail view now handles trashed tasks correctly instead of breaking, and the search toggle is larger and easier to tap on mobile.
0.31.0-local-only: You can now use the app fully offline with no account - your data stays on the device - and upgrade to a synced, end-to-end encrypted account later without losing anything.
0.31.0-local-passcode: Local-only data can be protected with an optional passcode, adding a lock on top of on-device storage when you aren't using an account.
0.30.0-folder-sync-desktop: On desktop browsers your notes can be mirrored one-way into a local folder on your computer, nested paths included - a live Markdown copy on disk that you control.
0.30.0-support-link: A heart icon in the navigation bar links to ways you can support the project's development.
0.29.0-saved-searches: Save any search as a smart folder that re-runs its query each time you open it, keeping a filtered view always one tap away.
0.29.0-native-share: On Android and iOS, shared links now open straight in the app, and you can send a note out through your device's native share sheet.
0.28.0-periodic-dedup: If the same daily, weekly, or monthly note was created on two devices while offline, sync now detects and merges the duplicates into one.
0.28.0-live-hr: A line of three dashes now renders as a horizontal divider in the Live Preview editor.
0.28.0-code-copy: Code blocks now have a one-tap copy button, and their last line is selectable.
0.27.0-longer-sessions: Signed-in sessions now last up to 30 days before you need to re-enter your password.
0.26.0-push: Task reminders can now reach you as push notifications, even when the app is closed.
0.25.0-forced-colors: Selected items stay visible in Windows High Contrast (forced-colors) mode instead of blending into the background.
0.24.0-share-markdown: Anyone viewing a read-only share can now copy its contents or download it as a Markdown (.md) file.
0.23.0-shares: Publish a read-only snapshot of a note or task list behind a private link. It stays end-to-end encrypted: the decryption key lives in the link's # fragment, which browsers never send to the server, so the server only ever stores ciphertext.
0.22.0-multiselect: Select several notes at once to move, delete, or reorganize them in a single action.
0.20.0-sso-unlock: Unlocking one app now unlocks the other: re/notes and re/task share a single end-to-end encryption key, so one password entry covers both.
0.19.0-task-lists: Add interactive checkboxes inside a note and tick items off in place.
0.18.0-periodic-notes: Daily, weekly, and monthly notes, with a calendar view to move between them.
0.18.0-settings-sync: Your app preferences now sync across devices, end-to-end encrypted like the rest of your data.
0.17.0-search-operators: Search gained a real query language: field operators, quoted phrases, negation, and OR grouping, so you can narrow results precisely.
0.15.0-reminder-timing: Choose how far ahead a reminder fires, and set the default time of day for reminders that only carry a date.
0.14.0-inline-images: Images render inline in the Live Preview editor, with click-to-load so a remote image isn't fetched - and your IP isn't exposed to its host - until you ask for it.
0.13.0-live-default: Live Preview is now the default editor mode, with a one-time intro that lets you switch back to plain Markdown if you prefer.
0.12.0-editable-tables: Edit Markdown tables visually, cell by cell, directly in the Live Preview editor.
0.11.0-live-code: Code blocks render with syntax highlighting in the Live Preview editor.
0.10.0-live-preview: A new Live Preview editing mode renders Markdown formatting inline as you type, instead of showing raw syntax.
0.9.0-subfolder-search: Searching within a folder now also covers everything in its subfolders.
0.8.0-initial-sync: The first sign-in on a device now shows clear progress while your encrypted data downloads.
0.6.0-pdf-export: Export any note to PDF through your system's print dialog.
0.5.0-subfolders: Organize your notes in nested folders.
0.4.0-markdown-import: Import a folder of Markdown files, choosing where they land and how duplicate names are handled.
0.2.0-offline-reliability: Offline sessions now restore reliably after a restart, and the sync indicator reflects real connectivity instead of just the browser's online flag.
0.1.0-first-release: re/notes and re/task went public under the AGPL-3.0 license after almost a year of private development: end-to-end encrypted notes and tasks, open source from here on.
